observed_clues: steady reported rail pressure did not exclude fuel contamination
owner observed a light surface layer with a slight foamy white boundary in the fuel sample
symptoms resolved after the suspect fuel was diluted with fresh gasoline
scanner data showed effects but did not measure fuel composition
cases.lesson: When pressure is acceptable but combustion is unstable and fuel quality is unverified, include an early representative fuel-sample inspection. Do not infer contamination from OBD data alone.
cases.provenance: Owner-reported visual sample evidence and resolved outcome; contaminant identity not independently laboratory verified
